notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Clues.
description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.
